Name: CP - Emily's Makeover
Author: Rosza6193
Description:
[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936286956030140456/936386152225718272/EmilysMakeover_TitleBig.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936286956030140456/936386577725288559/BeforeAfter_Happy_Med.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][i]Hey there farmers[/i], thank you so much for downloading my mod! [/size]
[size=4]This is my first mod for Stardew Valley, and my first time making pixel art portraits. [/size]
[size=4]I am just starting out learning pixel art, so I made this new look for Emily to practice portraits, and thought I'd share it here~[/size]
[size=4]I did try my best to match CA's pixel art style, so it would look as natural as possible.[/size]

[size=4]This is likely not the final version of this mod, as I have ideas for alternative looks in the future with different coloured hair, eyes, different clothes, etc. I also want to make new versions of other characters as well, so stay tuned!

If you like my work, please don't forget to endorse~[/size]

[i][size=3]Note: If you are new to using mods in Stardew Valley, [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Index#Using_mods]click here[/url]﻿ to get started![/size][/i][/center]



[left][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936286956030140456/936384803354345483/Installation.png[/img]
[size=3]* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿
* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿
* Download this mod and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder
* Run the game using SMAPI[/size][/left]



[right]﻿[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936286956030140456/936384803622756393/Uninstalltion.png[/img]
[size=3]* Just delete the [CP] EmilyMakeover file from your mods folder and that's it![/size][/right]



[left][size=3][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936286956030140456/936389650019401860/Thanks.png[/img]﻿
Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher
The great folks over on the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Discord[/url]﻿ server for their feedback![/size][/left]

Downloads.Description:
For content patcher; Replaces Emily's character portraits with a new look in ConcernedApe's style!

Contains two versions; One with cleavage for Emily's beach appearance, and one without.
